text:
maya: heads up — deployed RBAC tighten for keystore-reader (PR #4631) to ap-south at 2026-03-20T11:22Z. immediately started seeing TLS handshakes fail for services behind proxy-ap-south.

devon: observing same. proxy shows KMS unwrap denies and then handshake aborts. snippet below.

aleks: paste exact error lines pls.

devon: ```
2026-03-20T11:22:58Z proxy-ap-south-01 svc=proxy trace=tx1 KMS:Decrypt DENIED principal=svc-proxy-keystore key=keystore-main reason=IAM_DENY
2026-03-20T11:22:59Z proxy-ap-south-01 svc=proxy cert_cache_hit=false verify_err=missing_intermediate
2026-03-20T11:22:59Z proxy-ap-south-01 svc=proxy tls: handshake error: no shared cipher
```

kyle: likely root cause: tightened role inadvertently removed kms:Decrypt for the proxy principal in ap-south. without unwrap, proxy can't present full chain or rotates to stale cert -> SNI mismatches for subset of hosts.

sre-oncall: marking incident P1. @kyle you're oncall, can you triage? :rotating_light:

kyle: on it. first step -> confirm with KMS/audit logs. @audit-bot run query region=ap-south event=Decrypt result=DENIED since=15m key=keystore-main

audit-bot: ```
AUDIT> query --svc=kms --region=ap-south --event=Decrypt --result=DENIED --since=15m --key=keystore-main
- 2026-03-20T11:22:58Z principal=svc-proxy-keystore@redwood.internal action=Decrypt key=keystore-main reason=IAM_DENY
- 2026-03-20T11:22:59Z principal=svc-proxy-keystore@redwood.internal action=Decrypt key=keystore-main reason=IAM_DENY
```

maya: confirmed — the PR removed kms:Decrypt from the new least-privilege binding. I missed adding an explicit allow for svc-proxy-keystore. apologies.

aleks: mitigation options:
- fast rollback of RBAC change (ap-south only) -> quickest restore
- patch role to re-add kms:Decrypt for the proxy principal -> safer but needs review
- enable proxy fallback to serve cached full chain for short TTL if unwrap fails -> defensive

devon: ops-bot: please revert RBAC change in ap-south now. we need traffic flowing.

ops-bot: ```
ops> rbac rollback --region=ap-south --deploy=rbac-4631
ops> status: started
ops> status: complete at 2026-03-20T11:25:12Z
```

sre-oncall: post-rollback metrics: handshake failures dropped from 450/min to baseline ~5/min in 90s.

kyle: next steps for compliance/audit: export KMS audit slice and produce timeline for SOC. @audit-bot can you export 11:15->11:30 for keystore-main ap-south?

audit-bot: exporting -> s3://redwood-audit-exports/2026-03-20/keystore-main-ap-south-11_15_11_30.json

maya: opening SEC ticket SEC-7342 to track fix: keep least-privilege but explicitly allow kms:Decrypt for svc-proxy-keystore, add unit tests for RBAC -> KMS unwrap path, and add one-line change log.

aleks: add postmortem checklist items: - add automated RBAC preflight check that queries KMS IAM bindings for affected principals - add canary test during RBAC deploy that performs keystore unwraps against a shadow keystore - ship KMS Deny alerts to SIEM (we had 2 denies before anyone noticed)

devon: note: ~120 tenants had cert chains missing intermediate in proxy cache; when unwrap failed they returned `missing_intermediate`. we re-pushed intermediate to cache and rotated certs for impacted tenants.

kyle: ops ask: add rotator change — on unwrap DENIED, rotator should attempt exponential backoff retries (3 attempts) before failing, and emit structured metric `keystore.unwrap.retry` with tags {region, principal, key} so we can alert on spikes.

maya: will include in fix PR. also will run a global KMS ACL audit across regions and produce mapping of service principal -> key perms by EOD.

sre-oncall: closing incident when stable for 30m. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
